gates.description: RelationalValidator passes on beneficiary, enrollment, chronic conditions, and inpatient claim linkage.
Fit paths refuse holdout and diagnostic finding IDs.
Mean absolute error on frozen calibration moments (training diagnostic, not generalization proof).
Holdout discrepancy may be reported for transparency; must not enter model selection or iterative retuning in Phase 5.
For Level B worlds: ESS > 0, positive weights, no declared infeasibility; extreme weight collapse is a warning.

notes: Holdout and diagnostic findings are evaluate-only; never fit on them.
Structural validity is a hard release gate; evidence MAE is graded.
Synthetic agreement is not a Medicare finding.
